info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Clinopt Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Management API facilitates the creation and management of Clinopt Battery details within the catalog. This endpoint allows users to submit new details for Clinopt Batteries, ensuring that the catalog is up-to-date with accurate and relevant information. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, inventory systems, and e-commerce platforms that need to maintain comprehensive product listings. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their product information, streamline operations, and improve customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a new ClinOpt battery detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for a ClinOpt battery. It accepts the necessary data in the request body and returns the created battery detail along with its identifiers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information for the ClinOpt battery operations. It expects a JSON payload that conforms to the specified schema, allowing for the structured input of necessary details.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details returned.
